description:
## [1.43.3-dev.1](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/compare/v1.43.2...v1.43.3-dev.1) (2026-10-10)

✨ New App Support

🎬 XPlayer

- Added Mod Settings menu with customizable UI controls.
- Added Extra File Info to display additional information for video and folder entries.
- Added Hide Bottom Bar and Hide Cast Button patches.
- Added Clean Bottom Sheets and Clean Player Menu patches.
- Added options to hide Cast and Fast Forward buttons in player controls.
- Added Clean Player Sidebar patch.
- Added Hide Widget Menu Item, Hide Home Tiles, and Hide Recent Videos patches.
- Added Remove Tutorial and Disable Rate Dialog patches.
- Added Skip Splash Screen patch.
- Added Volume Booster patch.
- Added Unlock Pro patch.

📸 Video to Photo

- Added support for the Video to Photo app.
- Added Unlock Pro patch.
- Note: The premium purchase nag is not yet limited to appearing only once after a fresh installation.

🎞️ All Video Player

- Added Remove Bottom Bar patch.
- Added Skip Splash Screen patch.

🦊 Firefox

- Updated compatibility with newer Firefox Nightly builds, including version code "2016189151".
- Improved fingerprint matching for more reliable patch application.
- Improved patch logging to make skipped modifications easier to diagnose.

🎞️ MX Player

- Reworked the signature verification patch to address high CPU usage.
- Fixed signature verification patch behavior.
- Updated the Unlock Pro patch description.

🧩 Universal Patches & APK Cleanup

- Added an APK cleanup rule for "app-update-ktx.properties".
- Improved ProGuard configuration with additional AndroidX warning suppression.
